assessments.reasoning: The instructions given to the interviewer for recording sex or gender, as well as any definition of sex or gender, would be documented in Part 1 of the interviewer manual or in the sociodemographic questionnaire (Batería I: Características sociodemográficas), which was not supplied in this run. The supplied document (Part 2 of the interviewer manual) covers Baterías III through XI and Annexes, focusing on labor context, business characteristics, working hours, income, secondary employment, job search, and other activities, and does not contain the sociodemographic section or instructions for recording sex or gender.
